graphic.text: Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 6004, the first switch in the family of Cisco Nexus 6000 series is a key component of the Cisco Unified Data Center architecture, complementing the existing Nexus family of switches.The Cisco Nexus 6004 is a 4-rack-unit (4RU) 10 and 40 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE switch offering wire-speed performance for up to: 96 x 40 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE ports OR 384 x 10 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE ports (using QSFP+ breakout cables) Overall throughput of 7.68 Tbps Rich L2 & L3 feature set at scale Low latency of ~1 µsec port to port The Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch can be deployed in multiple scenarios as shown below to build a scalable Cisco Unified Fabric across a diverse set of physical and virtual server environments in data centers: High-density FEX Aggregation Direct-attach 10 and 40 Gigabit Ethernet server-access Leaf and spine architectures Compact aggregation Please refer to the link below for more information on the Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch: http://www.cisco.com/go/nexus6000

The Cisco Nexus 6004, the first switch in the family of Cisco Nexus 6000 series is a key component of the Cisco Unified Data Center architecture, complementing the existing Nexus family of switches.The Cisco Nexus 6004 is a 4-rack-unit (4RU) 10 and 40 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE switch offering wire-speed performance for up to:
96 x 40 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE ports OR
384 x 10 Gigabit Ethernet/FCoE ports (using QSFP+ breakout cables)
Overall throughput of 7.68 Tbps
Rich L2 & L3 feature set at scale
Low latency of ~1 µsec port to port

The Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch can be deployed in multiple scenarios as shown below to build a scalable Cisco Unified Fabric across a diverse set of physical and virtual server environments in data centers:
High-density FEX Aggregation
Direct-attach 10 and 40 Gigabit Ethernet server-access
Leaf and spine architectures
Compact aggregation

Please refer to the link below for more information on the Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch:
http://www.cisco.com/go/nexus6000

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 6004 Switch is a four-rack-unit (4RU) 40 and 10 Gigabit Ethernet and FCoE switch offering up to 7.68-Tbps throughput switching performance and up to 96 40GE ports per fully populated system. The switch has 48 40GE fixed QSFP+ Ethernet/FCoE ports with the base of the chassis and four expansion slots. The chassis currently supports 12 x 40GE Line Card Expansion Module. Many other expansion modules are planned in future.
